summary: Layer 1B expansion for the underfollowed lane found several US-listed industrial/electrical names with plausible exposure to AI data-center power-delivery bottlenecks. Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova and Quanta remain the context anchors, but the discovery lane points to switchgear/packaged-power vendors, electrical contractors/infrastructure integrators, connection-and-protection components, and conduit/cable-management suppliers. The strongest evidence in this pass is for Powell Industries and IES Holdings because both have recent company-reported backlog or demand commentary tied directly to data centers. nVent is included as a higher-market-cap but relatively pure electrical connection/protection name after its Avail Electrical Products Group deal. Atkore is included as a more cyclical, lower-confidence conduit/cable-management second-order beneficiary. This is research-universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
